subject: Intro: Redwood Inference — 30m demo & stakeholder options
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Amit Sinha <amit@pulse.ai>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@pulse.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: Redwood Inference — 30m demo & stakeholder options

Hi Amit (and Lina),

Thanks again for the product demo earlier — great conversation. Quick recap and a suggested next step so we keep momentum:

Recap (30s):
- PulseAI is evaluating inference options for your assistant product, primary goals are lower per-token cost and consistent p99 latency across mixed-traffic spikes.
- Key constraints: GDPR data residency in EU for analytics, and a hard limit on 100ms p50 for API-facing endpoints.
- Stakeholders you called out: Engineering (infra/serving), Product (roadmap prioritization), and Platform/Security for compliance.

Proposed next step: 30-minute technical intro + Q&A where we walk architecture, rollout options (hosted vs dedicated), and quick cost/latency examples. I can tailor the session to whichever two stakeholders you want in the room.

I opened 3 options below — pick one that fits you and Lina, or tell me alternative windows:

Option A — Thu Jan 14 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT (Engineering + Product)
Option B — Thu Jan 14 — 3:00–3:30 PM PT (Platform/Security + Engineering)
Option C — Fri Jan 15 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT (Product + Platform/Security)

If none work, share 2 alternative 30-minute slots and I’ll coordinate.

Attachment: Redwood_Intro_OnePager.pdf (one-page summary you can share internally)

Next steps / ask for you:
- Choose A/B/C or propose times
- Let me know which two stakeholders we should prioritize for the walkthrough

Thanks — I’ll hold the times locally and send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

--
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical
From: Amit Sinha <amit@pulse.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@pulse.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood Inference — 30m demo & stakeholder options

Thanks, Soojin — good summary. Lina and I reviewed and we want the session to focus on latency SLA strategies and private deployment options (we have compliance questions).

Option B (Thu Jan 14, 3:00–3:30 PM PT) works best for us. Lina will forward a calendar invite from our side if that helps, otherwise please send yours.

One quick ask for the deck / session: can you include a short slide on fallback policies and example billing implications for burst traffic? That will help our finance folks understand the tradeoffs.

Amit
VP Product, PulseAI
amit@pulse.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199
